title: Move the Close and land row of run/mod.rs into run/close.rs
summary: Structure pass job R4: move close_dispatched, land_or_block, retry_landing, closing_subject, landing_body, build_text and the small formatters from run/mod.rs into new run/close.rs, text unchanged, public paths kept by re-exports. The audience is the maintainers and verifier judging the structure pass. Depends on R1 (20261026-232423-hvyb, abandoned and superseded; R1's result is in the base through its retry, so nothing is redone), R3 (20261026-232429-r147, landed; its planning.rs, pin.rs and mod.rs changes are kept as they are) and G7 (20261026-232414-p8n4, landed; its landing.rs and gh re-exports are kept and not touched). G7's findings concern gh CHANGELOG entries and don't apply here. R3's nit, that the per-name caller check is missing from the report, is addressed by listing it per name in the CHANGELOG entry.

defaults_applied.how: fmt, clippy and test checks are required criteria.
One row moved, in one focused change.
Test-list and text-identity criteria check that behavior is unchanged.
The verifier runs the cargo checks.
The CHANGELOG entry is written for an outside reader.
BRIEF.md asks for tagged releases and a changelog, so the change records itself in CHANGELOG.md.

assumptions: Code survey: read crates/athena-core/src/run/mod.rs (close_dispatched at about line 2205, land_or_block 2403, retry_landing 2586, closing_subject 2731, landing_body 2764, build_text 2786), the run/ directory listing (mod.rs, pin.rs, planning.rs, send_back.rs) and docs/design/structure-pass.md sections 2.2, 3.2 and 4. The change is a pure move, so no resolution or probing order, record allow-list or new data file is involved. The behavior is measured directly by the existing tests and the three cargo checks.
The row's current line range in mod.rs is found by name, since earlier moves shifted lines; items between them that belong to other rows stay put.
Tests for moved functions stay in mod.rs or move with their function as R3 did, import lines only; helper dedup is not done.
The retry_landing caller in main.rs resolves through the existing path, so main.rs is expected to need no edit; the earlier refused deliverable of a main.rs path is dropped.

acceptance_criteria.text: crates/athena-core/src/run/close.rs exists and holds close_dispatched, land_or_block, retry_landing, closing_subject, landing_body, build_text and the small formatters of the Close and land row, with bodies textually identical to the removed text in run/mod.rs (git diff shows only deletions from mod.rs matched by additions in close.rs, plus mod declaration, use lines, re-exports and pub(super) or pub(crate) visibility changes).

Public paths are unchanged: closing_subject and build_text stay reachable at their old paths under run (re-exported from mod.rs), and Grep over crates/ and xtask/ finds no caller path that needed editing beyond import lines.

Existing tests pass with only import lines edited: git diff shows no test function added, removed, renamed or changed in body, and the test list from cargo test --locked -- --list holds the same names, apart from the module path of any test module that moved with its function.

CHANGELOG.md has an R4 entry under Unreleased saying no behavior change and listing, for each moved name, the callers found by search (including main.rs for retry_landing and the gh::land_pr use), so a reader can check each name.
Run cargo fmt --all --check, cargo clippy --all-targets --locked -- -D warnings and cargo test --locked from the repository root; all exit 0.
Changes to athena.toml, defaults.toml and .github/workflows are absent from the diff; they are not needed.

out_of_scope: Moving any other row of run/mod.rs (producer, verifier, checks, candidate, verification)
Any behavior change, or test edits beyond import lines
Redoing R1, R2, R3 or G7, or rewriting their CHANGELOG entries
Editing gh/ files and callers in main.rs or drain.rs
departures: Medium-sized pure move of about 590 lines with per-name caller listing; slightly higher cost than the reference.
